Class Projectile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.cards.projectile.Projectile
Direct Known Subclasses:
CannonShot, Meteor
public abstract class Projectile extends Object
Represents a projectile fired at a player's ship, used in combat-related card effects. Projectiles have a size, a direction of origin (source), and a computed or predefined path index. Subclasses must define how the projectile interacts with a player (e.g., whether it can be defended against).

      public Projectile(Projectile.Size size, Projectile.Source source, int pathIndex)
      Constructs a new projectile with a predefined path index. Used primarily for testing or deterministic scenarios.
      Parameters:
      size - the size of the projectile
      source - the direction from which the projectile is fired
      pathIndex - the predefined path index (used instead of random dice roll)

    • evaluateDefense

      public abstract boolean evaluateDefense(Player player)
      Evaluates whether the given player is able to defend against this projectile. Implemented by concrete subclasses to handle different projectile effects.
      Parameters:
      player - the player to evaluate
      Returns:
      true if the projectile can be defended against; false otherwise

    • randomizePathIndex

      public int[] randomizePathIndex()
      Randomly determines the path index using two simulated dice rolls. If a predefined path index is already set (e.g., for testing), no change occurs.
      Returns:
      an array of two integers representing the dice rolls, or null if the path index was already set
